create.name: Will Caminada
create.bio:
Will Caminada is a Brazilian-born channel, breathwork guide and singer-songwriter who describes his work as multidimensional guidance. He began as a performer, touring Brazil with a vocal group before a scholarship took him to study contemporary music in London in 2013. A period living on an island in Thailand deepened his meditation and yoga practice, and after what he calls a time of intense awakening he released his debut EP, From Darkness To Light, in 2017, followed by a book of the same theme that pairs his own story with journal prompts, meditations and music.

His teaching today centres on channelled messages he attributes to the Pleiadians, on breathwork, and on frameworks of dimensions of consciousness. He works online with students around the world through recorded one-to-one channelling sessions on Zoom, multi-week group programmes such as The 5D Lightworker Gateway for people building spiritual practices and businesses, and short replayable workshops. Free offerings include a seven-day intention meditation series and a nine-day dimensions challenge. He also hosts a podcast, posts monthly energy themes and channelled talks on YouTube, and has said he plans a small group retreat in Glastonbury.

books.title: Soul Art: From Darkness to Light
books.author: Will Caminada
books.description: A memoir-led guide to spiritual awakening in which the author follows his own journey and invites readers to reflect on theirs. Each chapter comes with journal prompts, a guided meditation and a song he wrote.

courses.title: 1:1 Channeling Session with The Pleiadians
courses.description: A one-hour recorded Zoom session in which clients put their questions to him and the Pleiadians he channels. Pricing is offered in three tiers for the same session, and the recording is sent afterwards.

courses.title: The 5D Lightworker Gateway
courses.description: A five-module live online group for people who offer, or want to offer, spiritual and energy services. Sessions mix breathwork, guided meditation and planning work on balancing feminine and masculine energies in how they run their practice.

courses.title: The Starseed Relationship Activation
courses.description: A three-hour recorded workshop for spiritually minded people thinking about romantic partnership, with a PDF journal. The replay stays available for a year after purchase.

courses.title: Glastonbury Activation UK Retreat 2027
courses.description: A planned small-group residential retreat in Glastonbury, England, built around meditation, channelling and time at the town's sacred sites. Dates are not yet set; the page takes registrations of interest.

free_resources.title: Will Caminada on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His guided meditations and channelled messages on the free Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: 7 Days of Intention: A Meditation Challenge
free_resources.description: A free week of guided meditations on YouTube, each focused on one intention such as creativity, sovereignty or intuition. A printable sheet of the seven intentions comes with it.

free_resources.title: 9D Challenge
free_resources.description: A free nine-day series of emailed videos combining breathwork and meditation, one for each of nine dimensions of consciousness in his framework. Phone wallpapers with affirmations are included.
